description.value: Golden Sweets & Restaurant is an authentic Indian cuisine spot in Surrey specializing in butter chicken, Tandoori items, traditional thali, and Indian sweets made fresh daily. The menu spans a wide range of vegetarian and non-vegetarian dishes including Indian street food classics like Gol Gappe, Chaat Papri, and assorted pakoras. A touring cyclist looking for a filling, flavourful sit-down meal or a quick takeout stop will find a broad menu with something for most dietary preferences.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms a real, active Indian restaurant at 6377 168 St, Surrey matching the OSM address; the phone (604) 576-0800 is on the website but absent from OSM tags. The menu page features a dedicated VEG APPETIZERS section confirming vegetarian options, and the homepage prominently promotes online ordering, confirming takeout. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, or any cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content.
